name: cxr_screening_orchestrator
description: Chest X-ray screening orchestrator: chains the CXR tools (quality -> detect -> segment -> measure) via run_tool, merges their artifacts, and writes one combined grounded summary. Demonstrates multi-tool orchestration.

help.summary: Run the full CXR screening pipeline (quality, detection, segmentation, measurement) and ground a combined summary.

options.name: stages
options.description: Comma list of stages to run.

notes: Pure orchestrator (no model); chains the other CXR tools and degrades gracefully if a backend has no weights.
